quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Being truly happy for someone while privately measuring yourself against them points to a specific, uncomfortable feeling.
quests.explanation: Feeling real happiness for someone while quietly comparing your own life to theirs is the essence of jealousy.
quests.textToSpeak: My sister posts about her new house every week. I'm genuinely happy for her, but I've started checking listing prices in my own neighborhood more than I'd like to admit.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Checking for something you know isn't coming yet, again and again, points to an ongoing, restless unease.
quests.explanation: Repeatedly checking for news you know isn't ready yet is a clear sign of anxiety, a more restless cousin of nervousness.
quests.textToSpeak: The results aren't posted until Friday. I know that. I've still checked the portal eleven times since breakfast.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: A reward that requires sensitive information up front tends to raise a particular kind of doubt.
quests.explanation: Doubting an offer that seems too good to be true, especially one asking for private details, is healthy skepticism.
quests.textToSpeak: The email says I've won a prize from a competition I don't remember entering, and all they need is my bank details to release it.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: A plain, quiet evening described as exactly enough points to a warm, settled feeling.
quests.explanation: An ordinary quiet evening described as 'all I want' reflects a simple, settled happiness.
quests.textToSpeak: The kids are finally asleep, the kitchen's clean, and I'm sitting here with tea doing absolutely nothing. Some evenings, this is all I want.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: A confident bet on a better outcome that leaves you with nothing at all points to a deflated feeling.
quests.explanation: Confidently giving up a sure thing for a bigger one that falls through is a sharp, specific disappointment.
quests.textToSpeak: I turned down the smaller offer because I was sure the bigger one would come through. It didn't, and now I have neither.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: An unexplained request to talk, with no hint of the reason, points to a specific unease.
quests.explanation: Being asked to discuss something in person with no explanation given is a natural cause of worry.
quests.textToSpeak: My son's teacher asked to speak with us after school, but wouldn't say what it was about over the phone.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Sending genuine-sounding congratulations while privately hoping for the opposite result points to a mixed, uncomfortable feeling.
quests.explanation: Congratulating someone while privately wishing the outcome had gone differently is a common, honest form of jealousy.
quests.textToSpeak: My old classmate just got the promotion I quietly hoped would be mine one day. I sent a nice message. I meant maybe half of it.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Understanding a decision logically while still needing a private moment to process it points to a quiet feeling.
quests.explanation: Needing a private moment to sit with a loss, even one you understand and agree with, is a real sadness.
quests.textToSpeak: My parents finally sold the house I grew up in. I understand why. I still sat in the car outside for a while before driving off.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Deep familiarity with a repeating situation, down to predicting the next question, points to a settled mindset.
quests.explanation: Predicting exactly what comes next, from sheer repeated experience, is a clear expression of confidence.
quests.textToSpeak: I've walked prospective buyers through this house forty times. I already know exactly which question this couple is about to ask.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Unease with no specific cause, just a persistent sense that something's coming, points to a particular, ongoing feeling.
quests.explanation: A persistent, unfocused unease with no specific trigger is the clearest definition of anxiety.
quests.textToSpeak: Nothing is actually wrong right now. I just can't shake the feeling that something is about to go wrong, and I couldn't tell you why.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Someone remembering a small, personal detail you barely mentioned points to a warm feeling.
quests.explanation: Someone remembering a small personal detail, unprompted, weeks later, is a quiet cause of gratitude.
quests.textToSpeak: My physiotherapist remembered, three appointments later, a small detail about my father I'd mentioned only once in passing.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: A small, surprising detail casually dropped into conversation, then never mentioned again, draws out one particular feeling.
quests.explanation: A brief, unexplained glimpse into someone's past that's never mentioned again naturally sparks curiosity.
quests.textToSpeak: My quiet uncle mentioned, almost as an aside, that he'd once turned down a job because it would have meant moving to another country. He's never brought it up since.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: A single product promising to solve several unrelated problems at once tends to raise a particular doubt.
quests.explanation: Doubting a product that claims to solve too many different problems at once is a reasonable skepticism.
quests.textToSpeak: The new supplement claims to fix sleep, focus, and joint pain, all with one capsule a day. My cousin swears by it.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Discovering an unplanned, joyful moment captured by someone else points to a warm feeling.
quests.explanation: Discovering an unexpected, joyful moment captured on film is a simple and warm happiness.
quests.textToSpeak: We got back the photos from the wedding today. There's one of my grandmother laughing that I didn't even know had been taken.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Careful, repeated effort to understand something that keeps working against itself points to a stuck feeling.
quests.explanation: A document that contradicts itself no matter how carefully you read it is a clear source of frustration.
quests.textToSpeak: I've read the tenancy agreement four times now, and the clause about the deposit still contradicts itself depending on which page you're on.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Comparing your own effortful reality to someone else's curated outside view points to a specific, uncomfortable feeling.
quests.explanation: Comparing the hard parts of your own life to the easy-looking parts of someone else's is a common, human jealousy.
quests.textToSpeak: My best friend's relationship looks effortless from the outside. Mine takes so much work lately. I know that's not the whole picture, but some days it's hard to remember that.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: A child choosing honesty over an easy, undeserved credit points to a warm feeling.
quests.explanation: Watching a child choose honesty over an easy advantage is a quiet, meaningful source of pride.
quests.textToSpeak: My daughter told her teacher, without being asked, that the answer she'd been given credit for was actually her classmate's idea.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Actively avoiding thinking about something upcoming points to an ongoing, low-level unease.
quests.explanation: Actively avoiding your own thoughts about something upcoming is a quiet but clear sign of anxiety.
quests.textToSpeak: The scan is booked for next month. I've noticed I've started avoiding the topic entirely, even in my own head.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Being honest with one group and not applying the same honesty elsewhere points to an uncomfortable feeling.
quests.explanation: Giving one excuse to one group while acting differently elsewhere is a clear cause of guilt.
quests.textToSpeak: I told my team I couldn't take on the extra project because I was stretched too thin. Then I said yes to a friend's favor that took just as long.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: A claim that directly contradicts a written record from just months earlier tends to raise real doubt.
quests.explanation: A claim that contradicts a recent written record is a reasonable basis for skepticism.
quests.textToSpeak: The landlord says the water damage was 'already there' when we moved in, despite the inspection report showing no such thing three months ago.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Letting yourself imagine a future you're not sure will happen points to a forward-looking feeling.
quests.explanation: Letting yourself imagine an uncertain but appealing future is a natural, grounded form of hope.
quests.textToSpeak: The new manager mentioned, just once, that flexible hours might become policy next quarter. I've already started imagining what I'd do with the extra time.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Adjusting to a lasting absence by replacing it with something that fills the silence points to a quiet feeling.
quests.explanation: Quietly adjusting to a missing daily presence, by filling the silence some other way, is a familiar loneliness.
quests.textToSpeak: My partner works nights now. I've gotten used to eating dinner with a podcast instead of a person.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Someone completing a difficult, self-directed project late in life points to admiration.
quests.explanation: Completing an ambitious, self-directed project at any age is a genuine cause of being impressed.
quests.textToSpeak: My father-in-law, at seventy-four, just finished building a boat in the garage from a design he adapted himself.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: A small, specific, repeating disturbance right where you least want it brings a familiar irritation.
quests.explanation: A small, specific disturbance repeating for two weeks straight is a very relatable annoyance.
quests.textToSpeak: The upstairs apartment has had the same dripping tap sound for two weeks, right through the wall behind our bed.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Doing unrelated tasks to distract yourself while waiting for news points to a restless, ongoing feeling.
quests.explanation: Distracting yourself with unrelated tasks while waiting on uncertain news is a common form of anxiety.
quests.textToSpeak: The offer letter should arrive today. I've reorganized my desk twice this morning for no real reason.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Choosing to repeat something simple, on purpose, rather than wanting more, points to a calm, settled feeling.
quests.explanation: Deliberately choosing simplicity over something bigger, and meaning it, reflects quiet contentment.
quests.textToSpeak: We didn't do anything for our anniversary this year. Just the two of us and the same takeaway we always get. I wouldn't change it.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Careful preparation for a specific version of something that changes right before it matters points to a deflated feeling.
quests.explanation: Preparing carefully for something that changes right before it counts is a sharp, specific disappointment.
quests.textToSpeak: I trained for eight months for this interview format specifically. They changed the format the week before mine.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: A glowing description that doesn't quite match the basic facts tends to raise a particular doubt.
quests.explanation: A description that doesn't match the plain facts in front of you is a reasonable basis for skepticism.
quests.textToSpeak: The review says the hotel has 'stunning ocean views.' The map shows it's four streets back from the coast.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Someone addressing a problem you never even said out loud, with real discretion, points to a warm feeling.
quests.explanation: Someone quietly solving a problem you never spoke about, without ever making it awkward, is a deep cause of gratitude.
quests.textToSpeak: My daughter's swim coach quietly waived the fee for the season without either of us ever bringing up that we couldn't afford it.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Two true, opposite reactions to the same news happening within the same hour points to a specific, layered feeling.
quests.explanation: Feeling genuine warmth toward someone and private envy at the very same time is an honest description of jealousy.
quests.textToSpeak: My cousin got into the university I was rejected from twice. I hugged her at the party. I also went home and cried in the car.
